title: Shannon diversity and estimated genome size
legend: Canonical top-ten-superfamily Shannon entropy against estimated genome size for overlap21, derived from IOD and anchored to the D. fuscus assembly. Columns show all 21 species and post-hoc reproductive strata of 6, 13, and 2 species. Horizontal intervals are conditional measurement intervals. Lines and coefficient confidence bands are Pagel-lambda PGLS fits; the two direct developers have no fitted regression. These estimates are not direct species C-values, and the strata are descriptive.

title: Gini-Simpson diversity and estimated genome size
legend: Canonical top-ten-superfamily Gini-Simpson index against the same estimated genome sizes and intervals. All-species and reproductive-strategy columns retain 21/6/13/2 observations and shared x limits. Pagel-lambda PGLS fits and coefficient confidence bands are shown only where n is at least 3. The n = 2 direct-development panel intentionally has no fit; post-hoc strata do not establish causal effects.
